children.name: Glaciimonas frigoris
children.description: Glaciimonas frigoris is a Gram-negative, psychrophilic, rod-shaped and motile bacteria from the genus Glaciimonas which has been isolated from the permafrost from Siberia.

children.name: Glaciimonas immobilis
children.description: Glaciimonas immobilis is a psychrophilic, nonmotile, rod-shaped, Gram-negative bacterium of the genus Glaciimonas which was isolated from alpine glacier cryoconite.

children.name: Duganella sacchari
children.description: Duganella sacchari is a bacterium of the genus Duganella in the family Oxalobacteraceae which was isolated with Duganella radicis from the rhizosphere of field-grown sugarcane.

children.name: Duganella radicis
children.description: Duganella radicis is a bacterium from the genus Duganella in the family Oxalobacteraceae which was isolated with Duganella sacchari from the rhizosphere of field-grown sugarcane.

children.name: Pseudoduganella violaceinigra
children.description: Pseudoduganella violaceinigra is a mesophilic bacterium of the genus Duganella in the Oxalobacteraceae family which was isolated from forest soil in Yunnan Province in China.

children.name: Herminiimonas glaciei
children.description: Herminiimonas glaciei is a species of ultramicrobacterium in the family Oxalobacteraceae.

children.name: Herbaspirillum seropedicae
children.authorship: Baldani et al. 1986 emend. Baldani et al. 1996

children.name: Telluria mixta
children.description: Telluria mixta (formerly called Pseudomonas mixta) is a species of Gram-negative soil bacteria that actively degrades polysaccharides including dextran, inulin, pectate, starch, and xylan.

children.name: Massilia brevitalea
children.description: Massilia brevitalea is a Gram-negative, strictly aerobic non-spore-forming short rods bacterium from the genus Massilia and family Oxalobacteraceae, which was isolated from lysimeter soil.

children.name: Massilia putida
children.description: Massilia putida is a Gram-negative and motile bacterium from the genus Massilia with a single polar flagellum, which has been isolated from a wolfram mine in Dayu County in the Jiangxi Province in China.

children.name: Massilia eurypsychrophila
children.description: Massilia eurypsychrophila is a Gram-negative, aerobic, rod-shaped and facultatively psychrophilic bacterium from the genus Massilia with a polar flagella which has been isolated from the ice core of the Muztagh Glacier in Xinjiang in China.

children.name: Massilia tieshanensis
children.description: Massilia tieshanensis is a Gram-negative, non-spore-forming rod-shaped, motile bacterium from the genus Massilia and family Oxalobacteraceae, which was isolated from a metal mine soil in Tieshan District in central China.

children.name: Massilia alkalitolerans
children.description: Massilia alkalitolerans is a Gram-negative, rod-shaped, non-spore-forming bacterium from the genus Massilia and the family Oxalobacteraceae.

children.name: Massilia aerilata
children.description: Massilia aerilata is an aerobic, Gram-negative, rod-shaped, motile bacterium from the genus Massilia and the family Oxalobacteraceae which was isolated from air samples in the Suwon region of the Republic of Korea.

children.name: Massilia arvi
children.description: Massilia arvi is a Gram-negative, aerobic and non-motile bacterium from the genus Massilia which has been isolated from soil which was cultivated with Brassica oleracea.

children.name: Noviherbaspirillum canariense
children.description: Noviherbaspirillum canariense is a Gram-negative bacterium which was isolated from old volcanic mountain soil on Tenerife on the Canary Islands.

children.name: Noviherbaspirillum agri
children.description: Noviherbaspirillum agri is a Gram-negative, rod-shaped, aerobic and motile bacterium from the genus of Noviherbaspirillum which has been isolated from grassland soil from Biratnagar in Nepal.

children.name: Noviherbaspirillum aurantiacum
children.description: Noviherbaspirillum aurantiacum is a Gram-negative and motile bacterium from the genus of Noviherbaspirillum which has been isolated from old volcanic mountain soil.

children.name: Noviherbaspirillum malthae
children.description: Noviherbaspirillum malthae is a Gram-negative, aerobic and rod-shaped bacterium from the genus Noviherbaspirillum which has been isolated from Kaohsiung County in Taiwan.

children.name: Noviherbaspirillum suwonense
children.description: Noviherbaspirillum suwonense is a Gram-negative, aerobic, rod-shaped, mesophilic and motile bacterium from the genus of Noviherbaspirillum which has been isolated from air in Suwon in Korea.

children.name: Janthinobacterium aquaticum
children.description: Janthinobacterium aquaticum is a Gram-negative, rod-shaped and motile bacterium from the genus of Janthinobacterium.

children.name: Janthinobacterium lividum
children.description: Janthinobacterium lividum is an aerobic, Gram-negative, soil-dwelling bacterium that has a distinctive dark-violet (almost black) color, due to a compound called violacein, which is produced when glycerol is metabolized as a carbon source.

children.name: Rugamonas rubra
children.authorship: Austin and Moss 1987 emend. Jeon et al. 2021
